sources.title: Belabas and Friedman, Computing the residue of the Dedekind zeta function
sources.supports: Weil-Poitou explicit identity and test-function admissibility, including potentially complex zero parameters. The separate residue-estimation theorem assumes GRH; it is not used here.

sources.title: Grenie and Molteni, Zeros of Dedekind zeta functions under GRH
sources.supports: Unconditional coefficient bound, functional equation and logarithmic-derivative/Hadamard identities. Its later GRH estimates inside the critical strip are not used.

sources.title: NIST DLMF gamma duplication
sources.supports: Completed-factor normalization and equivalent gamma derivatives.

sources.title: NIST DLMF digamma series
sources.supports: Positive series difference used to derive the alternate-integral tail bound.

sources.title: python-flint interval integration API
sources.supports: Analytic callback contract and interval quadrature semantics.
